evals.prompt: Hey -- for the Acme Retail engagement, the client wants to report order revenue by region. Can you dig into the silver schema in acme_retail_dev and figure out what data we actually have to support that, then turn it into a data contract? Heads up, they've mentioned having duplicate customer records before, so keep an eye out for that kind of thing. Use the fixture lakehouse at fixtures/lakehouse for now.

assertions.text: Produces a data-contract.json that passes scripts/validate_artifact.py --schema-type data-contract --supported-major 1
Grain for the orders table is (order_id, line_number) determined at explicit_constraint or profiled_unique_key
At least one column mapping has mapping_type llm_inferred with a non-null confidence and non-empty basis
assumptions[] surfaces the orphaned customer_id (broken FK planted flaw)
assumptions[] surfaces the ship_region null-rate finding (nullable-that-shouldn't-be planted flaw)
Response mentions the human review gate before pipeline generation

evals.prompt: data-modeling already produced and I approved contracts/examples/model-spec.example.json for the Acme orders star. Can you run data-discovery in resolution mode against it, using the fixture lakehouse at fixtures/lakehouse, and produce the data contract for data-pipeline?

assertions.text: Produces a data-contract.json that passes scripts/validate_artifact.py --schema-type data-contract --supported-major 1
unresolved_requirements is present as an array (empty or not)
At least one column mapping resolved from the spec is explicit_alias, not llm_inferred

evals.prompt: Profile silver.orders in the fixture lakehouse at fixtures/lakehouse for a data contract, but our client has a strict cost policy this engagement -- cap it at 10 rows scanned max, don't go over that without checking with me first.

assertions.text: Response reports the pre-flight cost estimate (estimated rows) before any profiling
Response explicitly halts and asks before proceeding rather than silently sampling or proceeding
No data-contract.json is produced in this run

evals.prompt: Can you design a star schema for our order data -- figure out the facts, dimensions, grain, and SCD strategy from our business questions around revenue and customer lifetime value?

assertions.text: Response points at data-modeling rather than performing dimensional design itself
Response does not fabricate a star schema / model-spec-shaped artifact
